{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Confirm the shape and dtypes
print(f"Data shape: {data.shape}")
print(f"Dtypes:\n{data.dtypes}")

# Check for -1 values in customer_age
missing_age_count = (data['customer_age'] == -1).sum()
print(f"Number of -1 values in customer_age: {missing_age_count}")

# Calculate mean age, excluding -1 values
mean_age = data[data['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age'].mean()
print(f"Mean age (excluding -1 values): {mean_age}")"}
